Reference architecture for Public Information API:

Serve documented public data with search, pagination, sorting, filters, structured errors and a small test suite.

Deliverables should include source code, explicit contracts, isolated configuration, automated tests, normal and failure-case results, security review, and deployment/recovery notes. The implementation must be verified against the selected package versions and target runtime.
explanation: Reference architecture outline only. Do not treat a project brief as an implemented solution or claim external integrations, runtime tests or deployment unless they were actually completed.
